# LeadMeAlone product facts

> Public facts and evidence boundaries for LeadMeAlone local business lead generation software.

## Official product

- [LeadMeAlone](https://leadmealone.com/): Local business lead generation and website proof software for freelancers, students, and small agencies.
- [Product reference](https://leadmealone.com/local-business-lead-generation-software.html): Product purpose, workflow, and audience.
- [Research method](https://leadmealone.com/research-methodology.html): Public-source and opportunity-scoring boundaries.
- [Founder](https://www.vinodchinnannavar.in): Vinod Chinnannavar.

## Key facts

- The Free plan includes three saved leads and one website draft.
- No card is required for the Free plan.
- Missing public data stays unknown.
- An opportunity score does not prove private ad accounts, revenue, buying intent, or willingness to buy.
- LeadMeAlone does not guarantee search rankings, AI citations, leads, sales, or revenue.
